baseline.aggregation: max daily risk over the whole observation period

ewma_formula: e_t = lam * risk_t + (1 - lam) * e_(t-1), e_0 = risk_0, lam = 1 - 2^(-1/half_life)
iso_fpr_method: threshold per OOF repeat and validation fold, from the scores of benign users in the OTHER 4 folds

exposure_adjusted.reference: benign users of the other 4 folds (same repeat); all sliding windows of the user's length; each reference user weighted equally
exposure_adjusted.rule: alert iff max daily risk over n days > T_alpha(n), T_alpha(n) = weighted (1-alpha) quantile of benign window maxima of length n

horizon_start_rule: benign: the first H workdays of the observation period (and, as robustness, every sliding H-window); attackers: the H workdays starting at the first injected attack day

mixed_duration_experiment.rule: each dev user gets one H uniformly at random; benign: window start uniform over valid starts; attackers: window start uniform among starts whose window contains the first injected day
